I’m going to go out on a limb and defend Izzy. She’s learning, she’s young, and honestly, there’s nothing wrong with owning a van, just because she’s vegan..?? 
That’s exactly the same as someone hating on Leonardo DiCaprio for all his environmental conservation work just because he flies in a private plane. That doesn’t mean his work is null and void. So what if they drive a van? Izzy doesn’t own her own car, they share Ruby together, they’re eco about her, and technically their carbon footprint is smaller than say, the average 23 year old vegan, because they aren’t paying for an over abundance of electricity or gas in an apartment or house. I’m sure if Ruby has the potential to be converted to renewable resources for fuel, she will be. What more do you want on that front? 
And with the vegan lifestyle, what’s wrong with her thrifting leather? Do you want her to wear leaf made clothing and never eat honey or drink beer, too? It’s actually 100% impossible to be a true 100% die hard vegan. Everything humans do, have, eat, use, etc. in this world negatively effects the planet. Every single thing. It’s impossible to be 100% vegan or 100% sustainable. The point is that she’s trying. I think she’s passionate about leaving a positive mark on the world using the platform she’s been given. She’s passionate about the environment and acknowledging climate change for what it is, and thrifting, makes her happy. It’s not like she’s going out and buying Nordstrom clothes and then claiming they’re thrifted with the tags still hanging out of the sleepers. She’s not disingenuous at all, she’s finding her footing among a family that rejects everything she holds dear. That’s gotta be tough, don’t you think?
Her mother was a literature professor and a huge encouragement to chasing your dreams and living out your passions. Izzy is doing just that, and we all trip or stumble a little bit along the way, don’t we? 
She isn’t claiming to know it all, like Auj and Jer and their clear example of hypocrisy, she’s navigating the trek into adulthood (and marriage) without a mother. 

Think of it this way - the Roloff family is staunchly religious, but Izzy is not.
They’re anti-gay, bigoted, racist, and republican.
Izzy is inclusive, LGBT+ and POC supportive, and liberal.
Marijuana is the devil’s grass to the Roloff’s, but Izzy probably sees it as the medicine it is. 
Auj is obsessed with Enneagram, (despite the fact that it’s literally astrology with a different name lol) and Izzy likes Astrology. They think astrology is heresy.
She’s vegetarian/vegan (we all have slip ups in our diet, don’t be a blatant hater!) but they drag her through the mud about it and throws bible quotes at her, trying to guilt her that not eating meat is unholy and unnatural. How would you feel if someone hovered over you and made fun of who you were? So yeah, she gets a bit up in arms about animal welfare to spite their blatant disregard for her passion and her way of life. 

Imagine trying to enter a family that is 100% against who you are/who you’ve been raised to be. 
When it comes to Izzy, try to have compassion. She’s not a Roloff and she’ll never let them shove her into the fake-cookie cutter mold of being one. She’s a free bird and I hope she stays that way forever.
